name: Medical-Grade Peels
intro: A course-based option for pigmentation, texture and congestion, with the strength adjusted to suit your skin.
statement: A course-based option for *pigmentation, texture and congestion.*
suits: Most skin types looking for a lower-downtime option, often as part of an ongoing plan.
notSuitable: Active skin infection, certain sensitivities, or recent more intensive treatment in the same area.
assessed: Skin condition and any recent treatments are reviewed to confirm suitability.
before: Skin is cleansed and assessed before treatment begins.
during: Your practitioner applies the treatment, adjusting pressure and product to your skin's response.
after: Skin may appear slightly flushed immediately afterwards, settling within a few hours.
risks: This treatment carries minimal risk; mild sensitivity or temporary redness is possible.
